caveats: Adaptive retrospective development; no independent or clinical validation.

v14 orthogonalizes the v13 Door-1 subgates: the shared -H+zSLFN11 term enters ONCE as Door1_Backbone (Door-1 drugs only); the three subgates are mechanism-gene residuals. This is a design hypothesis, not a validated taxonomy; the v13-vs-v12 benchmark was prediction-neutral.
Nested L1 heads (logistic_*_l1) add L1 support selection with tuned lambda and unpenalized refit; they are a collinearity guard, not a validated accuracy gain.
RAD51C enters as mRNA expression: transcriptional-silencing hypothesis, NOT a validated HRD assay.
BRCA12_alt and MBD4_alt are cached likely-LOF binary flags; unsupplied flags default to wild-type with a warning.
E3 missing uses training-menu median without rescaling.
No new-donor Chronos; RICTOR expression proxy has poor inherited LODO diagnostic.
Efflux mask is a supplied hypothesis; nonnegative coefficient may be zero.
Core heads cannot score drugs outside their training menu.
ADC surface and payload recommendations are hypothesis generation only, not validated clinical payload prediction.
Frozen H/S input scores retain inherited reference-scale provenance.
